quiz.title: sciences : phénomènes naturels, corps humain, espace
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
The human heart indeed has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles.
Earthquakes, tornadoes, and volcanic eruptions are all natural phenomena.
The Milky Way is indeed a galaxy that contains our solar system.
Solid, liquid, and gas are all states of matter.
Photosynthesis is indeed the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy.
The stomach, liver, and intestines are all parts of the human digestive system.
The Earth does indeed revolve around the Sun, completing one orbit approximately every 365 days.
